name: nce-anki
description: Local-first spaced-repetition study app for the National Counselor Examination (NCE)

scripts.build:single: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode single && node -e "const{renameSync,rmSync}=require('fs');renameSync('dist-single/index.html','dist-single/nce-study.html');for(const f of ['sw.js','manifest.webmanifest'])try{rmSync('dist-single/'+f)}catch{}"
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run coverage && npm run test
